description: This file contains React components and utility functions for handling links, navigation, and trace attachments within a web-based HTML report viewer for test results, specifically related to Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on a predicate applied to URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component representing a styled clickable link that triggers navigation.

classes.name: LinkBadge
classes.description: Styled badge version of Link component.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component that creates a link to a project, displaying the project name with a label.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component that renders a link or expandable view for test attachments, including handling of content type and body.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component that provides a link to view a trace attachment for a test case.

classes.name: SearchParamsContext
classes.description: React context for managing URL search parameters.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Provider component that manages and updates URL search parameters.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Function to programmatically change the browser URL and dispatch a popstate event.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook that triggers a callback when a specific anchor is active based on URL parameters.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Hook that checks if a given anchor ID is currently active in URL parameters.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Function that generates a URL hash with test ID, result run index, and optional anchor.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL to view trace attachments.

methods.name: downloadFileNameForAttachment
methods.description: Utility to generate a filename for downloading an attachment.
